derived_fields.period_start_date/end_date: first/last observed day of the calendar month

limitations: Targets are derived, not real. The target-exceedance model therefore learns a synthetic label. Do not present its metrics as real-world exceedance prediction accuracy.
The first calendar month per household is dropped (no prior period).
Data represents 15-minute average kW; daily kWh is 0.25 * sum over intervals.
